messages:
elena: FYI: customer ACME (org_id=acme-21) filed a ticket — canary rollout health charts are stuck "in progress" since 06:10 UTC. Support page shows no heartbeat updates. Ticket #CS-12844.

elena: repro steps attached by customer: 1) create canary rollout, 2) trigger traffic, 3) observe canary UI stays "in progress" for >30m; metrics panel shows "no data". They included the deployment id `deploy-2026-03-17-22` and a screenshot.

deploy-bot: Deploy `deploy-2026-03-17-22` succeeded in us-west-2 at 06:04 UTC. Canary step 1 -> step 2 transitions OK from runtime side. :white_check_mark:

ryan_oncall: @elena can you paste the minimal repro logs / any error traces? is this just UI-level or the backend status stream too? :eyes:

elena: Pasting the customer's console debug log excerpt:
```
[06:12:11] status-sync: received event canary:deploy-2026-03-17-22 state=progress
[06:12:11] status-sync: queued update for chart-service
[06:12:12] chart-service: ack update but responds 202 (queued)
[06:12:40] status-sync: heartbeat missing for canary deploy-2026-03-17-22
[06:12:40] status-sync: retrying persist, no change
```

elena: UI shows the canary timeline lastUpdated = 06:12, but health chart still shows "in progress" with spinner. No errors in UI console.

tara_pm: Customer is on Dedicated plan; this is impacting multiple teams. They said billing page charged for inference but they can't tell rollout health. Escalating to SRE/Eng for a hotfix.

cher_eng: looking. Quick hypothesis: status-sync worker sometimes enqueues chart updates but the chart-service persistence layer drops updates when the status payload is empty (regression from the status normalization PR). I saw similar in staging yesterday. Can you share the service logs for chart-service?

mike_engineering: adding logs from chart-service (internal):
```
[06:12:11] chart-service INFO accept update id=deploy-2026-03-17-22 status=progress
[06:12:11] chart-service DEBUG normalize_status payload={}
[06:12:11] chart-service WARN persist skipped - empty metrics payload for id=deploy-2026-03-17-22
```

cher_eng: yep that WARN is the issue — normalization returned empty metrics and we short-circuited persist. status-sync keeps marking progress but chart never gets samples so UI shows spinning progress and "no data". Regression in commit `b4f2a9` (status-normalize).

ryan_oncall: Can we hotfix? What's the risk?

cher_eng: Plan: 1) push a 1-line guard to chart-service to accept and persist at least a heartbeat timestamp even if metrics empty (safe, non-destructive). 2) backfill missing timestamps for affected canaries via a short job. 3) patch status-normalize to not return empty payloads. I can do (1) now and open PR for (3).

cher_eng: Quick commands to run if we need immediate manual fix:
```
# force a resync for a specific deployment
curl -X POST "https://internal-api/services/status-sync/resync" -H "Authorization: Bearer $RESYNC_TOKEN" -d '{"deployment_id":"deploy-2026-03-17-22"}'

# backfill minimal heartbeat (db admin)
UPDATE canary_metrics SET last_heartbeat = NOW() WHERE deployment_id = 'deploy-2026-03-17-22' AND last_heartbeat IS NULL;
```

elena: Customer asked for ETA and whether we can avoid DB updates. They prefer service-level fix.

cher_eng: I'll roll the chart-service hotfix to canary first (us-west-2) and then to prod if green. ETA ~25-35m including tests. After hotfix I'll trigger the resync endpoint for affected deployments; should make charts populate.

ryan_oncall: OK please post PR link and the canary deployment ID for the hotfix so I can watch. Also add rollback steps.

cher_eng: PR https://git.internal/redwood/chart-service/pull/489 (WIP). Hotfix canary tag: chart-service:fix/heartbeat-1. Rolling now. Rollout id: rollout-hr-331. Will post logs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout `rollout-hr-331` started (canary) at 06:50 UTC. Monitor: 5m -> 30m.

mike_engineering: After hotfix canary logs show:
```
[06:53:02] chart-service INFO persist minimal heartbeat id=deploy-2026-03-17-22
[06:53:03] status-sync INFO requeued chart update for deploy-2026-03-17-22
```

elena: Customer confirmed charts updated at 06:54 UTC, spinner cleared, health timeline now shows samples. :white_check_mark:

tara_pm: Marking ticket CS-12844 as resolved pending postmortem. Customer notified.

cher_eng: Will open a short postmortem and link the regression commit + PR. Followups: add unit tests to status-normalize, add an integration test that ensures chart-service persists heartbeat even on empty metrics.

ryan_oncall: Thanks all. Please add the incident to 'postmortems' channel when ready.

elena: Noted. Closing support loop, will paste customer confirmation and ETA summary into the ticket.
